title: Jacob Steals Esau's Blessing

questions.question: Who helped Jacob deceive Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:6-10: Rebekah told Jacob the plan to deceive Isaac.

questions.question: What did Jacob use to feel hairy like Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:16: Rebekah put goatskins on Jacob's hands and neck.

questions.question: Who did Jacob impersonate?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:19: Jacob pretended to be Esau to receive the blessing.

questions.question: What did Esau plan to do to Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:41: Esau said he would kill Jacob after Isaac died.

questions.question: Was Isaac deceived by Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:23: Isaac blessed Jacob, thinking he was Esau.

questions.question: What sense did Isaac use to try to identify Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:21-22: Isaac felt Jacob because his eyes were dim.

questions.question: What did Isaac ask Jacob to bring him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:3-4: Isaac asked Esau (but Jacob came) to bring game.

questions.question: How did Jacob respond when Isaac asked if he was Esau?
What did Esau do when he realized the blessing was stolen?
options: Cried out with a great and bitter cry
questions.correctAnswer: Cried out with a great and bitter cry
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:34: Esau cried out with an exceedingly great and bitter cry.

questions.question: Why did Rebekah send Jacob away?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:42-45: Rebekah told Jacob to flee from Esau's anger.

questions.question: What blessing did Isaac give Jacob regarding the earth?
options: The dew of heaven and fatness of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: The dew of heaven and fatness of the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:28: "God give you of the dew of heaven and of the fatness of the earth."

questions.question: What would happen to those who cursed Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:29: "Cursed be everyone who curses you."

questions.question: What did Isaac prophesy about Esau's dwelling?
options: Away from the fatness of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Away from the fatness of the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:39: "away from the fatness of the earth shall your dwelling be."

questions.question: How would Esau eventually gain freedom according to Isaac?
options: When he grows restless and breaks the yoke
questions.correctAnswer: When he grows restless and breaks the yoke
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:40: "when you grow restless you shall break his yoke from your neck."

questions.question: Where did Rebekah tell Jacob to flee?
options: To her brother Laban in Haran
questions.correctAnswer: To her brother Laban in Haran
questions.explanation: Genesis 27:43: "flee to Laban my brother in Haran."

key_verse_text: 'Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers.'
